name: Subtitle Downloader
description: In-player subtitle search, sync matching, interactive drag-and-drop positioning, and multi-source downloading (OpenSubtitles, SubDL, and Jellyfin).
overview: Adds an in-player subtitle downloader with 64-bit video hash sync detection, interactive mouse drag-and-drop repositioning (Alt + Drag), and multi-provider support.

versions.changelog: Initial Release: In-player subtitle search and download, 64-bit movie hash sync, multi-provider support (OpenSubtitles REST API v2, SubDL, Jellyfin native), interactive drag-and-drop subtitle repositioning (Alt + Drag or position menu), and UTF-8 charset normalization.
